ai_analysis.summary: A promotional post claims to list actual American Express SQL interview questions for a 0–3-year Data Analyst role and advertises a 12–15 LPA package. It names duplicate detection, SQL joins, second-highest salary queries, window functions, cumulative sums, UNION variants, fraud detection with CTEs, pivoting, and year-over-year growth. The post does not provide table schemas, sample data, complete questions, SQL solutions, or answers. It advises candidates to write clean, optimized SQL and demonstrate logic, clarity, business understanding, and problem-solving rather than merely memorizing syntax.
